title: A Protocol for the Debt
author: Xanthe Zhou
blurb: Marguerite Iversen, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
